thread.title: Bears Rip Dow Jones Stocks On Earnings, China Fears | Investor's Business Daily

author: PAUL WHITFIELD
title: Bears Rip Dow Jones Stocks On Earnings, China Fears | Investor's Business Daily
text:
U.S. stock indexes stumbled Monday in late morning trade, as most stocks in the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell. The biggest losers in the Dow in late morning trade included Caterpillar ( CAT ) and Apple ( AAPL ).
X The Nasdaq dropped 1.4%, while the Dow and the large cap S&P 500 shed 1.3% and 1.1% respectively. Small caps as gauged in the Russell 2000 lost 0.4%.
Volume rose in the NYSE but edged down in the Nasdaq vs. the same time Friday.
In the Dow Jones Industrial Average, heavy machinery maker Illinois-based Caterpillar dived 7% in huge volume after earnings came in much softer than expected. Caterpillar blamed lower demand in China.
In the S&P 500, California-based semiconductor designer Nvidia ( NVDA ) lowered revenue guidance in a news release, pointing to weakening conditions in China. Nvdia gapped down 12% in torrid volume.
Shanghai's Negative Reversal World markets took hard hits too. China's Shanghai composite rose about 1.1% but then reversed to a 0.2% loss for the session.
Apple sliced off about 2% in average volume. Apple will report quarterly results after the market's close Tuesday.
While earnings and guidance are having an impact on stocks, weakness in China's economy and a lack of progress in the U.S.-China trade standoff are cranking up the pain.
Trade Talks Wednesday China and the U.S. will begin two days of trade talks Wednesday. Most market watchers aren't expecting a great deal from the talks. The real deadline is March 1 when the U.S. will jack up tariffs, if no agreement is reached.
Among IBD's 197 industry groups, airlines and homebuilders did the best. American Airlines ( AAL ) reported an earnings increase of 12% in Q4. The 12% gain was the best in six quarters. Homebuilder NVR ( NVR ) reported an earnings pop of 35%. The gain topped the Street's consensus view by 15%.
